How to play
01SailHold ↑ to accelerate, ← → to steer, and ↓ to brake.
02DodgeAvoid drone beams and impact circles. Watch for three drone pairs and salvos from both coasts. Space / E intercepts the cyan target.
03Collect suppliesClean passes earn random airdrops: double speed, an extra intercept, one life or Iron Dome. Every collected crate earns +250 points. Iron Dome automatically blocks up to 2 threatening missiles for 15 seconds, not drone beams. Life crates appear only when damaged. Two lives per voyage. Slow to 6 knots at the harbor.
